[![Discord 伺服器](https://img.shields.io/discord/1446530427337576541?style=for-the-badge&logo=Discord&logoColor=white&label=Discord&color=728ADA)](https://discord.gg/2P8kfceSmt) [![CurseForge 下載量](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1419290?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&logoColor=white&label=curseforge&color=F16436)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/refined-tools) [![Modrinth 下載量](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/6l1WUegn?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&label=Modrinth&color=1CD96A)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/refined-tools)

畫廊圖片尚未更新。所有模型都已經過重新設計。

![描述](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/899c0e364c509449cd21d46c78cd5a7775ff9951.png) 這個資源包改變了工具和武器，賦予它們增強的 3D 外觀。預設情況下，GUI 模型將保持 2D，使其與其他更改精靈圖的資源包相容。我非常推薦搭配 [Tools Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/tools-reimagined) 或 [Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reimagined) 或 [Fresh weapons and tools](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-weapons-and-tools) 使用！ 如果你想要在我的工具上出現附魔輪廓，可以使用以下其中一個模組：[Enchantment Glint Outline](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-glint-outline)、[Outline Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/outlinemod)
![重要](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6570fc1c8af37836ab6d9863e9b10a47862ff43.png)
推薦模組
1.21.5 及以下版本所需的模組
